info.name: MyStreeT API
info.description: Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (in order). Start the API in Development first so demo data/accounts are seeded.

exec: pm.test('Returns JWT, not admin', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.isAdmin).to.eql(false); pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', j.token); });
pm.test('Structured error CONFLICT', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql('CONFLICT'); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys('timestamp','path','error','message'); });

pm.test('Structured error VALIDATION_ERROR', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys('timestamp','path','error','message'); });

pm.test('Token returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', j.token); });
pm.test('Is admin', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.isAdmin).to.eql(true); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', j.token); });

pm.test('At least 8 products', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(8); const p = j.find(x => x.sizes.length && x.stockQty > 0); pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', p.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('productSize', p.sizes[0]); });
pm.test('Only Nike', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.above(0); j.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.brand).to.eql('Nike')); });
pm.test('All have size 9', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.above(0); j.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.sizes).to.include('9')); });
pm.test('Nike and size 9', () => { pm.response.json().forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.brand).to.eql('Nike'); pm.expect(p.sizes).to.include('9'); }); });
pm.test('Has detail fields', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p).to.include.keys('id','name','brand','description','price','sizes','stockQty','imageUrl'); });
pm.test('Structured error NOT_FOUND', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql('NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys('timestamp','path','error','message'); });
pm.test('Created and sizes normalised', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.sizesCsv).to.eql('8,9,10'); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdProductId', p.id); });
pm.test('Structured error FORBIDDEN', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql('FORBIDDEN'); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys('timestamp','path','error','message'); });

request.description: Client-supplied total/unitPrice are ignored; the test asserts the server price is used.

exec: pm.test('PLACED with id and server total', () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('PLACED'); pm.expect(o.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(o.items[0].unitPrice * o.items[0].quantity).to.eql(o.total); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', o.id); });
